Microsoft has introduced MAI-DxO, a clinical reasoning orchestrator for simulated diagnosis. It's designed to coordinate diagnostic steps, select the minimum necessary tests, and combine findings in simulated cases.

Microsoft says it reached 85.5 percent accuracy in a simulated game, with expert physicians averaging about 20 percent. A JAMA trial found doctors using AI didn't diagnose better.
